messages:
incident-bot: [P1] ALERT — Autoscale + GPU pool saturation detected in us-west-2. Queue depth rising above 800, paging oncall.

mike_oncall: I'm on it. Seeing elevated latency and 5xxs on hosted API. Confirmed the page. Notifying SRE and infra.

sara_infra: joining — linking aggregated logs: https://logs.redwood.internal/trace/0a1b2c (trace id: 0a1b2c).

mike_oncall: Customer impact: several customers reporting streaming stalls and timeouts. Routing fallback executed for some routes.

elaine_prod: Support has Acme Corp ticket for streaming failures. Marking as customer-facing and escalating.

david_sre: Quick snapshot: HPA metrics show controller not scaling fast enough; kube events show repeated imagePullBackOff / backoff on pod creation. Warmup pods stuck in Init:Pulling.

sara_infra: paste: `kubectl get hpa -n inference`
```
NAME           REFERENCE               TARGETS   MINPODS   MAXPODS   REPLICAS   AGE
inference-hpa  Deployment/inference    80%/80%   4         40        12         5h
```

mike_oncall: Queue proxy metrics: current_queue_depth=912 peak=1210 window=5m. 99th latency spiking to 9s.

todd_ml: Warmup jobs failing with `kvcache restore timeout` — warmups not completing, so new pods are serving cold.

ram_devex: Hypothesis H1: ECR/image-pull throttling + burst replica creation => slow readiness. HPA keeps increasing replicas but pods don't become Ready, queue piles up, GPU pool saturates.

sara_infra: Hypothesis H2: Warmup concurrency defaults are too high causing NFS/kvcache contention leading to write timeouts during warmup. Warmup logs: https://logs.redwood.internal/warmup/abcd

david_sre: Mitigation — temporarily bump HPA max and manual scale. Also switching imagePullPolicy to IfNotPresent where safe. Applying now.

mike_oncall: Manual scale command: `kubectl scale deploy/inference --replicas=30 -n inference` — executed. Observability: replicas increasing but many remain NotReady.

elaine_prod: Posting customer update to incident page and telling CS to triage high-touch customers. @support please queue follow-ups.

todd_ml: Warmup workaround: reduce concurrency from 10->2 for top models and re-run warmup orchestration; will run for top-5 models first.

ram_devex: Timeline (WIP): 00:00 alert fired, 00:03 imagePullBackOffs begin, 00:08 queue depth peaks, 00:12 manual scale applied, 00:22 warmup concurrency change; still seeing slow readiness on some nodes.

sara_infra: Kubelet logs show `createContainerConfigError: failed to register layer: quota exceeded` on several GPU nodes — possible ephemeral-storage pressure or overlayfs inode exhaustion.

david_sre: Action: cordon node-12 and drain; relocating pods off suspected nodes. Also raising infra request to increase ephemeral-storage for GPU ASG.

mike_oncall: Handoff: customer impact stabilized via partial fallback routing, but system not fully recovered. Handoff to night oncall @david_sre at 18:00 UTC. Continue RCA: collect ECR pull metrics, image-pull error logs, HPA controller logs, warmup traces.

incident-bot: Incident page updated: https://incidents.redwood/internal/IR-2026-447 assigned -> david_sre.

ram_devex: Labeling hypotheses in-thread: [H1 image-pull/ECR throttling], [H2 warmup concurrency/NFS contention], [H3 ephemeral-storage causing slow readiness]. Please add evidence lines under each hypothesis.

todd_ml: Evidence H2: warmup logs show repeated `kvcache write EIO` at timestamps coincident with queue spike.

sara_infra: Evidence H1: provider ECR pull_throttle metric jump: ecr.pull_throttle = 1020 between 00:02-00:06.

mike_oncall: Final before handoff — if any customer regressions, reopen with immediate page. I'll check back in 1 hour for status. :thumbsup:
